description: This file contains functions for processing, translating, and manipulating documentation files with frontmatter in a specific tagged format. It includes functions for reading files, parsing and formatting frontmatter and body content, applying translations, and handling file path resolutions.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: reads, splits, translates, applies frontmatter, and writes the output.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document string.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses a tagged document string into frontmatter and body parts.

methods.name: trimTagNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing newlines from a string.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Constructs frontmatter template lines and markers from data.

methods.name: markerPair
methods.description: Generates start and end marker strings for frontmatter fields.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Updates frontmatter data with translated content based on markers.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts value between start and end markers from translated text.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Sets a specific index value in the read_when list, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Decides whether to skip processing a document based on existing hash in frontmatter.

methods.name: extractSourceHash
methods.description: Extracts stored source hash from frontmatter data.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves absolute and relative paths for documentation files under a docs root.
